title: Pivot: from direction prediction to premium selling
detail: After 19 configurations with no directional edge, the four agents are retired. Gen 3 tests H1 (0DTE SPX variance risk premium, direction-free iron condor), H2 (regime filters judged by tail reduction, not profit factor) and H3 (documented intraday momentum on MNQ against a random-direction null). MES and SPY options are dropped. Gates for short premium: worst day, CVaR(95), max DD, Sortino.
